notes: «- أظنه -» is Abu al-Zubayr's own doubt about the name: left out
Asim narrates the expedition; Abu Ayyub's words («إني سمعت رسول الله يقول») are a Companion quoted as hearing the Prophet, so he is the last link (rule 6)
«أكذلك يا عقبة قال نعم» : Uqba assents in the scene and does not claim to hear the Prophet, so he is not a link
